test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: A sum of money doubles itself in 4 years at simple interest. In how much time will it become 7 times at the same rate of interest?
solution:
**Concept used:**

Simple interest = (P × t × r)/100

**Calculation:**

According to the question, if sum of money becomes 2P, then interest = P

(P × 4 × r)/100 = P

⇒ r = 100/4

⇒ r = 2</span
